d7df2dda-2718-41bf-b99e-ff6a2ae3dc10.quote: Xeebs' Renna played the midlane matchup the draft read as unfavored the whole game, and the line showed it: 3 kills, 6 deaths, 4 assists, and a vp swing of -24, the steepest drop on the team. Three of those six deaths came caught alone outside any group fight, more than anyone else on the roster, and two of them fed straight into enemy objectives, an outer tower off the 20.9 death and a Fangtooth off the 24.8 one. The build wasn't the gap: Renna was the only one of the five to complete the full winning core with nothing missing.

d7df2dda-2718-41bf-b99e-ff6a2ae3dc10.quote: Murdock finished Tainted Rounds, Imperator, Vanquisher and Sky Splitter, landing two of the three-item winning core, Vanquisher's flat execute and Imperator's 30% bonus critical damage, and swapping the third, Lightning Hawk, for Tainted Rounds and Sky Splitter. Tainted Rounds still delivered the healing cut Lightning Hawk doesn't offer, useful against Mourn and Muriel's stacked sustain, and Sky Splitter's current-health damage kept him relevant into tankier targets; Lightning Hawk's stacking slow would have added the extra kiting tool his low-mobility kit is built to need, since his own read is that anything that reaches him kills him. With 39,897 hero damage, the team's highest line, the swap cost little this game, but it's the one piece missing from the standard winning core.

d7df2dda-2718-41bf-b99e-ff6a2ae3dc10.quote: Revenant completed Scattershot, Imperator, Terminus, Tainted Rounds and Syonic Echo, five items but only Imperator from the three-item winning core; Vanquisher, the flat execute on low-health targets, never got built. Scattershot's homing projectiles and Syonic Echo's attack-speed reset lean the build toward sustained on-hit damage instead of the crit-execute spike Vanquisher and Imperator are built around, and Terminus' healing-to-shield conversion added survivability rather than kill power. His win condition is a 1v1 realm ult that needs to close a target out fast; without the execute piece, several of his five deaths came in extended fights rather than clean picks, against a Wraith lane that read unfavored the whole game.
